title: Microsoft Teams Adds AI Phishing Detection
excerpt: Microsoft plans to introduce AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection for Teams messages starting in early November 2026.
body_html:
Microsoft has announced upcoming security upgrades for its Teams platform, featuring the integration of artificial intelligence to spot phishing attempts. The new feature will bring context-aware phishing detection to messages sent within the platform.

According to the announcement, the rollout of this AI-driven security capability is scheduled to begin in early November 2026. The tool is designed to analyze message content and context to better identify and protect users against malicious social engineering threats.
